none: PAS KENT-F89233: Roman. Coin. Billon antoninianus copy of Claudius II Gothicus. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy with silver surface radiate or billon antoninianus contemporary imitation or barbarous copy of a Claudius II Gothicus (268-270AD) posthumous. Obverse: Crude radiate head right. Inscription: (DIVO CLAVDIO). Reverse: Eagle left - his ascent to join the Gods with head right. Inscription: CO[NSECRAT]IO. Minted in Britain by provenance. Reece period 14. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is slightly oval in shape, in fine condition, some wear with a green/brown patina and slightly silvery surface. This coin is likely to date to 270-285AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 59 & 79, 749, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece and…
